sources.summary: IE School of Architecture & Design (IE University) presents a lecture by Mexican architect Rozana Montiel as part of the School's COMMON(S) 2026-27 Lecture Series. Montiel's lecture is organized in collaboration with Fundación Casa de México and Fundación Monumental México. Rozana Montiel's practice is known for a socially engaged, community-centered approach to architecture, with a particular focus on public space, participatory design and the transformation of existing environments.
